ctaHeading: Reservoir's carpenters are ready — let's build your project.
aboutText: Based in Reservoir, Custom Carpentry & Design has been providing expert carpentry services to the local community. With years of experience, Axel and Joe specialise in door installation, gap sealing, and custom carpentry projects. They are known for their punctuality, attention to detail, and leaving the workspace tidy. From laundry doors to full renovations, they offer personalised service with on-site quotes to ensure accurate costing.
servicesText: From door repairs to custom built-ins, we handle all your carpentry needs in Reservoir and surrounding areas. Our services include installation, maintenance, and renovation projects, all delivered with professional precision and fair pricing.

services.title: Door Installation & Repair
services.desc: We install and repair all types of doors, ensuring smooth operation and a perfect fit for your Reservoir home.

services.title: Gap Sealing & Weatherproofing
services.desc: Seal gaps around windows and doors to improve energy efficiency and keep the elements out.

services.title: Custom Carpentry Projects
services.desc: Bespoke woodworking solutions tailored to your specific needs and design preferences.

services.title: Home Renovation Support
services.desc: Expert carpentry for kitchen, bathroom, and laundry renovations, enhancing your living space.

services.title: Furniture Assembly & Repairs
services.desc: Professional assembly and repair of furniture, from flat-pack to custom pieces.

services.title: General Maintenance
services.desc: Regular upkeep and minor repairs to keep your property in top condition.
